jobs.title: Software Designer (C++) - Image Guided Therapy
jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Software Designer (C++) - Image Guided Therapy

### **Job Description**

**Help shape the software behind Philips image-guided therapy systems.** Design, build, test and improve software used in X-ray imaging platforms for cardiac and vascular diagnosis and intervention. You will work on display software within the Imaging Chain Cluster and help keep complex, long-lived products reliable, maintainable and ready for future innovation.

  

**Your role**

* Design, implement and test software for the imaging chain of Philips X-ray systems, with a focus on display software for the Azurion platform.
* Translate system and subsystem needs into robust software designs, define interfaces and maintain clear technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.
* Develop and modernize at least C++ 11, C#, and working with legacy code on Windows, model-based design and automatic code generation.
* Work at the intersection of software and hardware, applying engineering practices that support quality, maintainability and compliance in a regulated medical-device environment.
* Collaborate in an Agile Release Train with software, system, hardware and quality stakeholders in the Netherlands and internationally.
Use continuous-improvement practices, pair programming and AI-assisted development to strengthen delivery, engineering effectiveness and product quality.  

  

**You're the right fit if**

* You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent field, and bring around five years of relevant software-development experience.
* You have strong hands-on experience with C++ and C, including legacy software, and are comfortable developing for Windows environments.
* You have experience with model-based design and automatic code generation, software-to-hardware interaction in complex systems, and TDD and BDD.
* You have experience working in a regulated industry and bring a can-do, continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to collaborate through pair programming and use AI-assisted software development.

**Nice to have:** experience in healthcare or MedTech.

  

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

  

**Compensation & benefits**

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is €61.185 – €101.976. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for 3% bonus, with your rewards linked to KPIs/company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

**Why should you join Philips?**

Working at Philips is more than a job. It’s a calling to create a healthier society through meaningful work, focused on improving 3 billion lives a year by delivering innovative solutions across the health continuum . Our people experience a variety of unexpected moments when their lives and careers come together in meaningful ways. Learn more by watching this video .

  

To find out more about what it’s like working for Philips at a personal level, visit the Working at Philips page on our career website, where you can read stories from our employee blog . Once there, you can also learn about our recruitment process , or find answers to some of the frequently asked questions .

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner - Image Guided Therapy (Display Software)
jobs.description:
### **Job Title**

Technical Product Owner - Image Guided Therapy (Display Software)

### **Job Description**

**Turn deep software engineering expertise into clear product direction for image-guided therapy.** As Technical Product Owner for display software in the Imaging Chain Cluster, you will connect hands-on understanding of complex software systems with backlog ownership, technical roadmaps and delivery commitments for Philips X-ray platforms, including Azurion .

  

**Your role**

* Own and prioritize the Scrum team backlog, prepare content for PI planning and align features with the technical roadmap and business priorities.
* Translate system, software and stakeholder needs into well-defined features and stories that enable the team to deliver maintainable, high-quality software.
* Estimate and roadmap features within the Agile Release Train, actively managing risks, dependencies and commitments across teams.
* Use your recent hands-on software engineering experience to challenge technical assumptions, guide trade-offs and partner credibly with software designers, engineers, architects and system stakeholders.
* Contribute to innovation in X-ray imaging and display software for the Azurion platform while supporting quality and maintainability in a regulated medical-device environment.
Drive continuous improvement and lean ways of working across local and international stakeholders.  

  

**You're the right fit if**

* You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or an equivalent field, with more than 10 years of technical software-development experience.
* You have recent hands-on software engineering or software design experience, including C++11 or later, C#, legacy code, and development in Windows environments. This is a technical Product Owner role rather than a project-management-led position.
* You bring more than 3 years of Product Owner experience and can translate complex technical needs into an effective backlog, roadmap and delivery plan within a Scrum team and Agile Release Train.
* You have experience with model-based design, automatic code generation, software-to-hardware interaction, TDD, BDD and AI-assisted software development, together with a can-do and continuous-improvement mindset.

**Nice to have:** experience in healthcare or MedTech and working in a regulated environment.

  

**How we work together**

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.

  

**Compensation & benefits**

Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is € 78.187– € 130.312. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for 3% bonus, with your rewards linked to KPIs/company results. We’ll share the full approach with you during the interview process, so you can make a clear, informed decision.

**About Philips**  
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose .
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care .

jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer (L5) - Distributed Data Systems
jobs.description:
P-67

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

Unlike traditional enterprise software, we design and build modern SaaS products that bring delight to all of the stakeholders: decision makers, admins, and end users. As a full stack software engineer, you will work closely with your team and product management to bring that delight through great user experience.

Below are some example teams you can join:

**SQL Analytics Console:** SQL Analytics is a new product that provides Databricks customers with a first-class experience for performing Business Intelligence (BI) and running SQL workloads directly on the data lake. Our team builds the "console" for SQL Analytics, where users configure, manage and monitor their SQL usage.

**Jobs and Workflows:** This team powers all asynchronous customer workloads for Databricks which is the majority of Databricks usage. As this usage has rapidly increased - we've rearchitected the system for increased stability and scalability. We are also building exciting new features for more advanced workflows and customer observability. This team has a mix of frontend, backend, and reliability engineering skills & projects.

**Developer Ecosystem:** The developer ecosystem team focuses on the development experience and best practices using toolsoutside of the workspace. We own and govern the core developer ecosystem open-source components: the SDK, the CLI, and Terraform.

**What we look for:**

* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, or a related field
* 7+ years of experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Passion for user experience and design and a deep understanding of front-end architecture
* Comfortable working towards a multi-year vision with incremental deliverables
* Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, VueJs/Ember)
* Strong familiarity with server-side web technologies (eg: Nodejs, Java, Python, Scala, C#, C++,Go, JVM)
* Good knowledge of SQL
* Experience with cloud technologies, e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes
* Experience in architecting, developing, deploying, and operating large scale distributed systems

**About Databricks**

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**  
  
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

**Compliance**

**If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.**

jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Software Development
Engineering
jobs.description:
HEMA wil het alledaagse leven beter maken. Tijdens je stage maak jij daarin écht het verschil. Binnen Engineering (Architecture, Cloud & Platforms) bouwen we aan het Microsoft-platform waarop meer dan 18.000 collega's dagelijks samenwerken. Van collega's in onze winkels tot medewerkers op kantoor: wij zorgen ervoor dat iedereen veilig, efficiënt en eenvoudig kan werken. Lijkt het jou interessant om mee te bouwen aan slimme digitale oplossingen? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

**dit ga je doen**

Tijdens je stage draai je volledig mee in ons agile team en werk je aan echte platformvraagstukken. Samen met je collega's werk je in sprints aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbeteringen en automatiseringen die direct impact hebben op duizenden HEMA-collega's. Je werkt onder andere mee aan:

* Automation-oplossingen die processen slimmer en efficienter maken.
* Digital Workplace-projecten binnen Microsoft 365.
* Ondersteunen bij Identity & Access Management vraagstukken.
* Bijdragen aan AI-initiatieven en innovaties.
* Het automatiseren en optimaliseren van interne processen.
* Het oppakken en realiseren van werkzaamheden uit de teambacklog.
* Actief deelnemen aan teamceremonies zoals refinements, sprintplanningen, demo's en retrospectives.

**dit bieden wij**

Bij HEMA werk je in een omgeving waar mensen écht samenwerken. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, wordt goed begeleid en krijgt feedback waar je écht iets aan hebt. Of je nu net begint of al ervaring hebt: bij ons ben je welkom. Daarnaast krijg je bij HEMA:

* Een stagevergoeding van €400 per maand op basis van 35 uur per week.
* De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken, waarbij je 2 dagen in de week vanuit huis kan werken.
* Door samen te werken met collega's binnen HEMA bouw je een sterk netwerk op, wat een goede basis vormt voor je carrière én misschien wel de ingang naar je eerste baan na je studie.
* ️ Om je stage-ervaring compleet te maken, biedt HEMA-inspiratiesessies en bijeenkomsten waar je met mede-stagiaires kennismaakt en waardevolle contacten opdoet.
* Begeleiding van een enthousiast en toegankelijk team, zodat je optimaal kunt groeien en je leerdoelen behaalt.
* 15% personeelskorting op al je HEMA-favorieten.

**dit breng je mee**

* Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in de richting van Technische Informatica, Software Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie.
* Je bent vanaf 1 Februari 2027 beschikbaar voor een meewerk- en/of afstudeerstage van minimaal 5 maanden.
* Je beheerst de Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en neemt graag initiatief.
* Je werkt graag samen en denkt in teamverband, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan gezamelijke resultaten.
* Je hebt affiniteit met Microsoft-technologieën en wilt je hier verder in ontwikkelen.

**jij maakt HEMA echt**

Bij HEMA werken we met ruim 17.000 collega’s aan een beter alledaags leven in een mooiere wereld. Met producten die praktischer, mooier, beter zijn en ook nog eens langer meegaan. Én met kleurrijke winkels in dorpen, steden en online. We zijn trots op hoe ver we zijn gekomen, maar we zijn nog niet tevreden. HEMA is weer écht HEMA en klaar voor de volgende stap. Onze ambitie? Koploper worden in een uitdagende markt. Dat doen we samen, als één team, met trotse collega’s, ondernemers en partners. Door te spelen om te winnen. Dat betekent dat je nieuwsgierig bent, kansen grijpt, met plezier samenwerkt en altijd gaat voor het beste resultaat. Je durft jezelf uit te spreken en anderen uit te dagen om samen beter te worden. Jij kunt met jouw unieke bijdrage meebouwen aan het HEMA van morgen. Jij maakt HEMA echt. Doe je mee?

**zo kun je makkelijk solliciteren**  

* **solliciteer hier!**

  Gebruik het formulier op deze pagina! We reageren binnen 2 werkdagen op jouw sollicitatie!
* **telefoontje**

  We stellen je een aantal vragen om te kijken of de functie bij je past.
* **eerste gesprek (online)**

  Is het een match? Ontmoet je toekomstige collega's en vraag ze alles wat je wilt.
* **assessment (online)**

  We ontdekken nog verder wie jij bent en wat jou drijft.
* **tweede gesprek**

  We leren je graag nog beter kennen.
* **aanbieding**

  We sturen je een voorstel met je arbeidsvoorwaarden.
* **overeenkomst**

  Tevreden met het voorstel? Dan maken we je overeenkomst in orde en kun je digitaal ondertekenen.
* **dubbelcheck**

  We controleren het officiële papierwerk en maken alles klaar voor een goede start.
* **welkom!**

  De rode loper gaat uit! Je begint bij HEMA.

**dit is je nieuwe werkplek**
